{
 "query": "dark luxury butcher meat ecommerce",
 "filters": {
  "industry": "food-beverage",
  "mode": "dark"

 "count": 4,
 "tip": "Thumbnails inline. Top rows carry the fold autopsy; get_screen(slug) for the others. Hero complete inside 1280x800; 80-160px between sections; copy in a centered padded column.",
 "images": "https://0nme3pk5am3urwa9.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/captures/<slug>/hero.1440.webp (also full.1440, thumb.384, mobile.384; get_screen returns exact URLs)",
 "results": [
  {
   "slug": "beardmeatsfood-co-uk",
   "title": "Beard Meats Food",
   "northstar": "High-contrast brutalist roar, chunky white type on charcoal with neon lime sparks",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top nav: hamburger left, logo center, \"SHOP\" button right. Headline: center-aligned, uppercase, massive scale, 2 lines (\"BEARD MEATS FOOD\"). Supporting copy: none. CTAs: two pill-shaped buttons bottom-center (\"YOUTUBE\", \"PODCAST\"). Hero visual: cartoon character integrated into the word \"MEATS\", occupying center 30% of viewport. Layout: centered vertical stack, headline/visual dominate 70% of 1280x800.\nTYPE: Display: ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif (Thunder), tight tracking; Body: standard sans-serif (Roboto). Extreme scale jump from headline to buttons.\nCOLOR: Background: #000000; Text: #FFFFFF; Accent: #bad306. Accent lands on small decorative spark icons and jagged circular borders.\nSIGNATURE: Massive, condensed uppercase typography where a cartoon character physically replaces the \"S\" in \"MEATS\" and overlaps the \"F\" in \"FOOD\".",
   "palette": ["#bad306", "#ecfb7e", "#667210", "#747474", "#c4c4c4"],
   "fonts": ["Thunder", "Roboto"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "marquee-hero",
   "axes": "dark / grotesk-sans / chromatic-other (~118) / Thunder",
   "tags": "brutalism, monochrome, playful, dark-mode · creator, food-beverage · loud, playful, raw · hero-fullbleed, hero-with-cta, sticky-nav"
  },
  {
   "slug": "onyxcoffeelab-com",
   "title": "Onyx Coffee Lab - Coffee Roasters • Café • Barista Training",
   "northstar": "Deep charcoal space, elegant script, and generous, airy arrangement feel quietly sophisticated.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Full-bleed hero image of coffee cherries fills viewport. Top nav: logo (circular mark, top-left), search bar + LOGIN + hamburger (top-right). Centered headline: \"Onyx\" in flowing script, ~3 lines, white. Below: small centered body copy, two sentences. CTA: pill button, white border, \"EXPLORE OFFERINGS →\". Bottom center: \"SCROLL\" with chevron. No sidebar; text overlays image entirely. Visual/headline balance: image 100%, text superimposed dead center, ~15% text, 85% photographic ground.\n\nTYPE: Display: script (Bajern), thin weight, high contrast strokes, connected ligatures. Body: sans (Montserrat), light, wide tracking. Scale jump: ~8:1. Signature: script headline set in white against dark cherries.\n\nCOLOR: Background: near-black photo (#0a0a0a). Text: white (#fff). Accent: muted red (#c0241c) in top \"Free Shipping\" ticker, green (#046104) location pins. Accent lands on utility bar, not hero.\n\nSIGNATURE: Oversized white script logotype \"Onyx\" centered directly atop photographic coffee cherries, creating the illusion the word is written across the fruit surface.",
   "palette": ["#c0241c", "#ee908b", "#046104", "#996e60", "#c9cbcc"],
   "fonts": ["Bajern", "Montserrat"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "specimen",
   "axes": "mid / grotesk-sans / warm / Bajern",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, dark-mode · food-beverage, ecommerce · calm, serious, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  },
  {
   "slug": "mixpotion-co",
   "title": "Potion",
   "northstar": "Grainy neon alchemy, bold white serifs floating on deep velvet purple",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top-fixed white marquee. Nav: centered white pill-shaped bar containing logo \"POTION\" (left), \"Shop Now\", \"Account\", \"Cart\" (right). Headline: Sentence case, center-aligned, large scale, 1 line: \"Supernatural Powders\". Supporting copy: Centered below hero, 1 line: \"Modern Alchemy for everyday transformation.\" CTA: White pill-shaped button \"Shop Now\". Hero visual: Three colorful powder sachets (Green, Orange, Pink) centered, occupying middle 40% of viewport. Balance: Vertical stack, centered axis, symmetrical.\n\nTYPE: Display: GT Alpina Condensed, high-contrast serif, condensed width; Body: Neue Montreal, geometric sans-serif. Large scale jump (approx 4:1).\n\nCOLOR: Background: #6c4494 purple gradient. Text: White. Accent: Sachet colors (#8ca404, #d25c25, #cd5f5b) on product packaging only.\n\nSIGNATURE: Floating white pill-shaped navigation bar centered at the top of a deep purple gradient background.",
   "palette": ["#d25c25", "#cd5f5b", "#8ca404", "#6c4494", "#c6b7c7"],
